idea-plugin.name: Preflight - Terraform Plan Viewer for AWS
idea-plugin.description:
Review Terraform plans and states of AWS infrastructure without scrolling through terraform plan output.

Preflight opens the JSON output of terraform show -json (plans or states) and terraform.tfstate files in a Preflight tab next to the text editor:

  • plan summary with filters by action (create, update, replace, destroy, read, forget, no-op);
  • attribute-by-attribute diff of each resource, unified or split, with known after apply and sensitive values, and IAM policies expanded and diffed key by key;
  • a graph of who can access what through IAM: execution roles, trust policies, attached, inline and resource policies, permissions boundaries, with the allowed actions and conditions;
  • AWS service icon next to each resource.

Open a plan with View as Terraform Plan (project view, editor tab or Tools menu), a state with View as Terraform State, which can also read the current state of a Terraform folder with terraform show -json (remote backends included).

Preflight is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon Web Services or HashiCorp.
